settings.heading: Delivery & returns
settings.content: Made to order in the UK. Most orders dispatch within 1–2 working days. Personalised items can't be returned unless faulty — if something's not right, we'll reprint it.

settings.heading: Personalisation tips
settings.content: Double-check spelling — we print exactly what you type. Photos look best at 1500px or larger. Emojis may not print on every product.
